Appendix G to Subpart V of Part 1926—Reference Documents The references contained in this appendix provide information that can be helpful in understanding and complying with the requirements contained in Subpart V of this part . The national consensus standards referenced in this appendix contain detailed specifications that employers may follow in complying with the more performance-based requirements of Subpart V of this part . Except as specifically noted in Subpart V of this part , however, the Occupational Safety and Health Administration will not necessarily deem compliance with the national consensus standards to be compliance with the provisions of Subpart V of this part .
